newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE GRAINS JUMP AS STERLING TUMBLES.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE GRAINS JUMP AS STERLING TUMBLES.

text.p: LIFFE grains firmed in good volume on sterling's fall, traders said.
"It's knee-jerk. That's all it is," one trader said.
By the close active November wheat was last traded 1.15 stg higher at 86.75 stg. November volume was 251 of the total 641 lots.
Barley also rose, with active November 1.25 stg higher at 81.50 stg on 98 of the total 188 lots.
Delivered grains also firmed on sterling, brokers said. But many market players ran for cover in the face of currency induced uncertainty, limiting volume, they said.

Sterling/mark tumbled nearly five pfennigs in afternoon trading after the Bank of England declared a quarter-point rate rise to 7.00 percent brought UK rates to levels consistent with its medium-term inflation target.
